device_interpretation: A vertically symmetric closed rounded-return waveguide enclosing two shorter central branch bars. The outer path is a racetrack-like loop with a nearly constant guide width. At the left and right, the inner branches enter the central upper and lower bars through straight-to-diagonal transitions. Each central bar is a broad rectangular interaction region containing two repeated rectangular clearances, leaving top and bottom rails around each opening.

topology_reasoning.outer_structure: One continuous rounded outer loop, represented as a closed polygonal centerline with straight side sections and sampled semicircular endcaps, extruded at wg_width.
topology_reasoning.inner_structure: Two mirrored horizontal branch assemblies centered vertically about the footprint midpoint. Each has a rectangular bar and two rectangular clearances; the side transitions are diagonal centerline segments joined to short horizontal sections.
topology_reasoning.symmetry: Mirror symmetry about both the vertical and horizontal footprint centerlines is strongly visible in the target.

calibration: calibration.json was generated from component.png and footprint.json before coding.

iterations.change_made: Initial rounded outer return plus four diagonal branch paths and two perforated central bars; corrected the first path-closure bug so the footprint matched 3.0 x 5.5 um.
Increased guide width, tightened central opening dimensions/placement, moved branch side heights outward, and moved branch entries toward the bar edges; this overfilled the transition wedges.
Retuned the outer loop to a taller rounded return and removed the long horizontal branch stubs, leaving only diagonal transitions. This was the best pre-final candidate.
Tried a target-sampled outer centerline assembled from explicit symmetric gf.Path samples; it introduced a seam notch and did not improve the score.
Removed the explicit loop-closing point as a seam experiment; the open-path cap was worse than the closed loop.
Restored the best closed outer return, narrowed the diagonal branch width, added short narrow side connectors at the measured junction height, and applied a small entry inset.
